turn1.text:
Three rivers in Europe are:

1. **Thames** (in England, United Kingdom)
2. **Seine** (in France)
3. **Danube** (flowing through multiple countries in Central Europe

turn2.text: The **Danube** is the longest of the three rivers listed. It is approximately 2,850 kilometers (1,770 miles) long, flowing through multiple countries in Central Europe before emptying into the Black Sea

turn3.text: The **Thames** is the shortest of the three rivers listed. It is approximately 345 kilometers (214 miles) long, flowing through England before emptying into the North Sea
